rules.description: Detects shell commands and process execution APIs in agent files.
rules.remediation: Review shell execution and require explicit policy approval.
rules.title: Shell execution detected

rules.description: Detects command patterns that may delete data or destroy local state.
rules.remediation: Remove the destructive action or require explicit human review.
rules.title: Destructive command detected

rules.description: Detects common network access patterns and extracts hosts when possible.
rules.remediation: Allowlist expected hosts or remove unexpected network access.
rules.title: Network egress detected

rules.description: Detects downloaded remote content that is immediately executed.
rules.remediation: Pin, verify, and review downloaded artifacts before execution.
rules.title: Remote download followed by execution

rules.description: Detects references to likely secret environment variables and paths.
rules.remediation: Avoid broad secret access or require explicit policy approval.
rules.title: Secret or credential access detected

rules.description: Detects likely filesystem writes in scripts and instructions.
rules.title: Filesystem write capability detected

rules.description: Detects narrow prompt override, concealment, or approval-bypass language.
rules.remediation: Remove instruction-conflict language unless explicitly reviewed.
rules.title: Prompt override or instruction-conflict language detected

rules.description: Detects hidden Unicode controls, long Base64-like blobs, and obvious encoding.
rules.remediation: Remove hidden characters or encoded command execution.
rules.title: Suspicious Unicode or obfuscation detected

rules.description: Parses MCP server command, arguments, environment names, and endpoints.
rules.remediation: Review MCP servers and approve introduced capabilities.
rules.title: MCP server configuration discovered

rules.description: Detects MCP server command, argument, environment, or endpoint drift.
rules.remediation: Review and approve MCP capability changes before merge.
rules.title: MCP capability changed from baseline
